videos.desc: In a dim brick foundry with wooden roof beams, a young man in safety glasses, a leather apron and heavy gloves tilts a long-handled crucible and pours glowing molten metal into a funnel on top of a sand-covered mould, as sparks fly. He lifts the crucible back and holds it still, and another man appears at the side. Beside them stands a life-size shiny bronze horse statue on a wooden base, and a bronze horse leg rises out of the sand in front. Old bells and ingots fill the shelves.

In the machine room inside an old bell tower, a large shiny brass disc with an egg-shaped outline turns on an axle between big gears and chains, and a vertical metal rod beneath it moves up and down. Pigeons fly off through beams of sunlight and feathers drift down. On the wooden workbench below, smaller brass discs of the same kind sit on a shaft next to oil cans. Through the slatted shutters a bronze bell hangs in front of a view of city rooftops.

Inside a dark foundry shed with a corrugated roof, a freshly cast metal horse statue glows orange-hot as it hangs from chains above a mould box, gripped by long tongs, while chunks of black sand fall away below it. A smiling worker in a leather apron and gloves stands beside it holding a hammer, and another worker with folded arms watches from behind. A furnace glows at the back, a pale wooden model horse stands on a bench, and the floor is covered in sand and metal moulds.

In an old brick metal workshop lit by a glowing furnace, a young man in a sleeveless shirt and a leather apron places a silver bar onto a pile of copper-coloured metal blocks on the pan of a large old balance scale with a brass arm. He then straightens up, rests his hands on the wooden table and looks at the scale. Brass weights, copper scraps in a tray, a small crucible and tongs lie on the table, and a woman works at the furnace behind him.

In a meadow with pine forest and mountains behind, a gloved hand tightens a bolt with a spanner on a metal plate that joins wooden beams. The view pulls back: a young woman in a white hard hat, denim overalls and a tool belt sits at the top of a large wooden dome structure with a small metal tool between her teeth, holds a new beam and raises the spanner. Below, a man stands on a yellow scaffold, two men hold a ladder and a dog lies on the grass.

In an old brick workshop full of wooden barrels, a young woman with her hair in a bun, a leather apron and work trousers kneels on the stone floor and swings a hammer above her head to drive a metal hoop down onto a wooden barrel, while tall flames and sparks rise from inside it. She hits the hoop, then stands up and wipes her forehead with her arm. Wood shavings cover the floor, barrels stand behind her, and an older man in a leather apron watches with folded arms.

On the scaffolding beside an old stone church at sunset, a young woman in white gloves, knee pads and navy dungarees kneels on padded blankets and steadies a tall stained-glass window panel in its stone arch with one hand, leaning her face very close to the glass. Behind her three men in white hard hats and work clothes stand holding straps. Warm light shines through the coloured glass. A coil of rope, a spirit level and a box of tools lie on the planks.

On a high rooftop building site at sunrise, a young woman in a white hard hat, an orange safety vest and a harness bends over wet concrete and drags a long aluminium straightedge back and forth across it, pushing the rough grey mix into a flat, shiny surface. Behind her two workers spread more concrete and a laser level stands on a tripod. A crane holds a load in the air, and tall towers rise out of a sea of clouds under a pink sky.

On an icy fjord at sunset, a young woman in a black beanie and a yellow drysuit sits in a red sea kayak and pulls a cord tight with her teeth and hands, tying together a home-made sail: a paddle and a pole lashed upright with a torn orange tent sheet and a silver emergency blanket stretched between them. Then she sits back, looks at a seal poking its head out of the water nearby and raises her fist. Chunks of floating ice surround the kayak.

In a small harbour town on a cloudy day, the huge, rusty black and red front of a cargo ship towers over the quay, its pointed bow pushing up white water, with a large anchor hanging on a chain. A small blue fishing boat bobs beside it in the waves. A worker in a yellow high-visibility jacket holds a thick rope tied to the ship, a German shepherd walks down the wet stone steps, seagulls fly, and colourful houses and a white lighthouse line the harbour behind.

A young man in a plaid shirt with a headlamp on his forehead crouches on a wooden porch at dusk after a storm, with a fallen tree in the yard behind. He pours gasoline from a red metal jerry can through a white funnel into a small portable generator. A lit oil lantern stands beside the generator, and a wrench and a coiled cable lie on the damp boards. A woman holding a torch watches from a window. He then stops pouring, lifts the can upright and turns to smile at her.

On a flooded country lane in the rain, a young bride in a muddy cream wedding dress crouches barefoot in the water at the front of an old white car and fastens a heavy steel hook on a tow cable onto the car's bumper. She then stands up and walks away, and the cable pulls tight through the brown floodwater towards a tractor further down the lane. Guests in suits and a bridesmaid with a bouquet sit barefoot on the car roof and clap, and white swans swim in the water behind.

In a deep trench dug under a city street at dusk, a young woman engineer in a white hard hat, an orange high-visibility jacket and work trousers climbs a ladder, holding on to a huge old riveted iron water main beside her, and looks up as she climbs. Around her the trench is crossed by more large pipes, a yellow gas pipe and bundles of black and orange cables, and an old brick sewer tunnel opens behind. Water trickles down the muddy walls, and above, cars pass on the road between lit brick buildings.

A dry desert village at sunset. A young woman with long braids and a yellow headscarf, in dusty overalls, kneels in the sand and catches clean water in her hands as it pours from a tap on a tall new machine covered in solar panels into a clay pot. She laughs, presses her wet hands to her face, then throws her head back and raises her hands in joy while the water keeps running into the pot. Behind her a workbench with tools and notes stands by rusty metal cabinets, and a crowd of children cheer and hold up cups, bowls and pots.

An old attic with bare wooden beams under a sloping ceiling. A woman in a plaid shirt, khaki work trousers, boots and grey work gloves crouches on the dusty wooden floor and levers up a loose floorboard with a metal bar, a puff of dust rising from the gap below. She lifts the board out with both hands, stands up and holds it upright beside the open hole in the floor, then looks down into it. A tin of old rusty nails stands beside her, planks are stacked against the wall and warm sunlight comes through a tall window.

A dark foundry lit by glowing metal. A young man in a shiny silver heat-proof suit, thick gloves and a raised face shield holds a long straight metal lance pushed into the tap hole at the bottom of a huge riveted furnace, and bright orange molten metal pours out into a channel at his feet. At first a fountain of white-hot sparks bursts from the top of the furnace, then it dies down to smoke while the metal keeps flowing and fills the channel. Another worker in a silver suit stands in the background.

On the icy deck of a red ship at night, with green northern lights in the sky and a big wave breaking behind, three workers in orange flotation suits, harnesses and black hats join two parts of a heavy rusty anchor chain. A bearded man raises a hammer and swings it down again and again onto a big shiny steel connecting link fitted between the rusty links, while the others hold the chain with metal bars and one heats it with a glowing torch. Frost and sea spray cover the deck and the winch.

In a sunlit woodworking workshop, a young woman with long wavy hair, in a dark hoodie and leather apron, crouches on the sawdust-covered floor and smiles up as a blank skateboard deck of pale, smooth maple wood falls from the air. She catches it, holds it across her knee and runs her hand along its smooth surface. Stacks of thin light wooden sheets lean against the wall, blank decks hang on a wall rack and a press, a band saw and a workbench stand around her. A dog sleeps under the bench.

A bright car design studio. A young woman in a grey clay-stained work coat, with a smudge on her cheek, pulls a toothed tool along the side of a full-size clay car, and a long curl of brown clay peels off and falls. In the foreground a small clay model of the same car stands on a round metal turntable, and clay shavings cover the floor. A young man shapes clay at a trolley on the left, a photographer takes pictures in the background and long ceiling lights shine overhead.

A bright carpentry workshop seen from above. A young man in a grey long-sleeved top and a canvas apron rubs oil into a long pale wooden table with a cloth. One strip of the table is already dark, glossy and golden with oil. A ginger cat walks across the dry part of the table, lies down near its edge and then gets off the table, and the man looks up and grins. An open tin stands in a small puddle of oil next to a pair of cotton gloves, and another man works on a chair behind.

At an oil field in a dry, sunny desert, thick, shiny black crude oil pours from the valve of an old rusty red wellhead into a metal bucket. The bucket is full and overflows, and the oil runs down its sides. The black puddle with a rainbow sheen around the bucket spreads wider and wider across the cracked pale ground. A coiled hose and a pair of oily black gloves lie nearby, and in the background a pump jack, storage tanks and a whirl of dust stand in the haze.

On a frosty village street on a cold winter morning, with stone cottages behind, a young woman in a knitted hat and a navy quilted jacket pushes down the long curved iron handle of an old cast-iron hand pump. A strong stream of water gushes from its spout into a metal bucket, fills it and splashes over the cobbles. A queue of villagers with buckets, metal milk churns and a wheelbarrow waits behind her, and a golden-brown dog drinks from the stone trough.

A sunny roof terrace. The view rises from open paint cans, a pink lid and a stirring stick on a dust sheet to a young woman in paint-splashed white dungarees on a stepladder. She tips a whole can of bright pink paint against a tall white wall, the paint pouring down in a thick stream and dripping onto the floor, then holds the empty can in front of her. On a wicker sofa behind her a young woman in jeans holds a drink and laughs. Potted palms and a line of small flags stand under a blue sky.

A small kitchen with orange tiles and wooden cupboards. A burst pipe shoots a jet of water up to the ceiling. A young woman in a wet blue T-shirt lies on the wet floor and reaches deep into the open cupboard under the sink to turn the water valve, her face tense. The jet stops, a plastic bowl falls to the floor, and she sits up laughing. A young man in a white T-shirt stands over her laughing, holding a saucepan of water. Dishes sit in a rack by the window.

A young woman in a green jumper sits at a small table in a room with wooden cabinets and warm wall lamps. Wearing a small magnifying lens on her head, she solders wires inside the open metal chassis of an old valve amplifier, and a bright spark flashes. She then picks up tweezers, frowns as she checks her work and smiles. A smiling young man in a white T-shirt holds up a glass valve beside her. A reel of solder and a tray of small tools lie on the table.

An old-fashioned hardware shop with a wall of small wooden drawers, coils of rope and brooms on hooks. A German shepherd dog in a green apron stands on its hind legs with its front paws on the wooden counter and hands a small screwdriver to a young man with curly hair in a terracotta T-shirt. He takes it, looks at it and laughs, holding a wooden stool under his other arm, while the dog pants happily. A few screws lie on the counter, a cardboard box leans against it, and a brass lamp hangs above.

A small car repair garage with a brick wall. An old cream car is raised on a lift with one wheel removed. A young woman mechanic in a navy top and rust-coloured overalls tied at the waist holds up a worn car part next to her phone and patiently explains it to a young man in a cream knitted sweater and black trousers. He scratches his head with a wide-eyed, confused look, then his face opens into a smile as she lowers the phone. A red tool chest, oil cans and a stack of tyres fill the garage.
